teams.h1: A team experience that puts focus, strategy and decision-making into play.
teams.lede: Chess gives people something real to think about together: recognising patterns, weighing options, planning ahead and making decisions. MadridMinds turns that into an engaging team experience that complete beginners can enjoy.
teams.beginnerNote: Designed so complete beginners can take part from the start.
teams.card1Body: Chess asks people to slow down, pay attention and stay engaged with the problem in front of them.
teams.card2Body: Every position creates choices. Teams weigh options, discuss ideas and decide what to do next.
teams.card3Body: Participants learn to look beyond the immediate move, recognise patterns and think ahead.
teams.card4Body: Everyone works on something new together, creating conversation, interaction and friendly competition.
teams.valueBody: MadridMinds combines active learning, mental challenge and social interaction in one experience. During the session, people use concentration, pattern recognition, planning, problem-solving and friendly competition — inside a shared game.
teams.agendaLede: About 90–120 minutes. Flexible group size and venue — at your office, a private room, or a space we help arrange.
teams.step1Body: The room is working before anyone has to introduce themselves.
teams.step2Body: Pattern recognition and collaboration with incomplete information.
teams.step3Body: The ideas of the game, without requiring anyone to already play.
teams.step4Body: Just enough to make the next challenge make sense.
teams.step5Body: Groups plan, decide and adapt under light time pressure.
teams.step6Body: Friendly, high-energy close. Then a short wrap-up.
teams.practicalWho: Teams and companies in Madrid. Designed so complete beginners can take part from the start.
teams.practicalLang: Available in English, Spanish or bilingual format.
teams.practicalWhere: Your venue, or a private room in Madrid.
teams.practicalGroup: Flexible — tell us the number when you write.

teams.faq1A: No. Designed so complete beginners can take part from the start.
teams.faq2A: Available in English, Spanish or bilingual format — whichever fits the team.
teams.faq4A: Your venue, or a private room in Madrid. Group size is flexible; tell us the number when you write.
teams.faq5Q: What kind of session is this?
teams.faq5A: A facilitated team experience built around play, puzzles and chess — active learning, mental challenge and social interaction in one format.
teams.finalLede: Tell us the group size, language and a window of dates. We will come back with a format that fits.

about.lede: MadridMinds brings together chess, conversation and a relaxed setting for adults who want to learn something new and spend an evening doing something genuinely engaging.
about.p1: Chess is one of the world’s great games: strategic, social and endlessly interesting. MadridMinds makes it accessible through carefully designed experiences where people can learn, play and enjoy the company around them.
about.p2: Every game asks you to focus, recognise patterns, weigh options, plan ahead and make decisions. The challenge is real, but the experience is designed to make it enjoyable.
about.p3: Experiences are hosted in English, giving MadridMinds a distinctive place in Madrid’s international and professional community.
about.atmosphereBody: Small groups, a comfortable setting, good conversation and time to actually engage with the people around you. Come to learn, come with a friend, or simply come because you want to try something different.
about.finalSub: Discover the MadridMinds experiences and find the evening that suits you.
